text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Iraq's information minister accuses the United States of impeding enhanced Iraqi-Turkish ties.
- Palestinians continue their uprising and the Security Council issues a loose resolution.
(The above stories were also carried by Qadissiya and al- Jumhouriya)
- Yemeni leader criticies Turkish attempts to set up a "security zone" in Iraq.
